profile.headline: Assistant Vice President; Software Engineer III
profile.summary: Software engineer with deep experience in automation engineering, large‑scale systems monitoring, and cross‑functional product delivery. Proven ability to design, build, and deploy enterprise‑grade automation, analytics, and sensor‑driven solutions supporting 400k+ devices across Bank of America. Strong background in AI‑driven tooling, data pipelines, and distributed systems, with research experience in blockchain, simulation platforms, and IoT networks. Adept at leading engineering initiatives, mentoring peers, and driving adoption of new technologies in fast‑paced environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Responsible for end of life software product removals.

positions.title: Delivery Lead - Technology
positions.description:
Development of automated DEX and device‑health solutions that were deployed across 400k+ endpoints, reducing non‑compliance by 65–80% depending on use case.

Designed and implemented custom sensor frameworks, personally contributing 34% of all team‑built sensors used for proactive detection and remediation.

Built a custom Tanium Engage notification package enabling targeted messaging that virtually eliminated by‑catch and improved user response rates.

Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver scalable automation aligned with enterprise standards, compliance, and Responsible Growth principles.

Drove adoption of reusable automation components and mentored engineering peers on best practices for data quality, and deployment.

positions.title: Senior Technical Analyst
positions.description:
Engineered automated dashboards, reporting pipelines, and proactive monitoring tools for enterprise teams using Splunk and custom automation.

Developed a proactive issue‑tracking platform that improved early detection and reduced productivity‑impacting incidents.

Served on the Proof of Concept (POC) team, evaluating new digital products and contributing to go/no‑go decisions for enterprise rollout.

Provided Level 2 support for 2,000+ remote and onsite users, ensuring operational continuity and rapid incident resolution.

Supported onsite recovery operations, including device setup, relocation, and continuity planning.

positions.title: Science Teacher
positions.description:
Founded and led the Cambridge Science program at Florida’s first full Cambridge high school.

Taught advanced courses including AICE Chemistry, Biology, Marine Science, Computer Science, Physics, and Environmental Science.

Delivered instruction in hybrid and online environments, leveraging digital tools and data‑driven teaching strategies.

positions.title: Scientific Researcher (Remote)
positions.description:
- Developed new simulation testing platform for blockchain technology while working on research for implementing blockchain into highly mobile IoT device networks. Funded by the National Science Foundation.
- Additionally held the role of team lead and training facilitator, in which I guided other program participants in meeting their weekly expectations and provided training related to the program requirements.

positions.title: Scientific Researcher (Remote)
positions.description:
- Research focused on Sensor Network Inter-Communication via Blockchain sponsored by the National Science Foundation (Grant# 1801552).
- Analyzing past technical research and identified areas of needed research.
- Refined and coded a simulation platform in Golang for data acquisition and continued research uses.

positions.title: Scientific Researcher
positions.description:
- Worked with Dr. Kia Makki as a contracted researcher to research alternate algorithms for the Minimum Spanning Tree problems.
- Presented technical research in easily understandable presentations for peers working on other projects.
- Funded by the National Science Foundations (Grant# 1801552) as part of the RET program offered by Florida International University.

positions.title: Technical Manager
positions.description:
-Resolved onsite technical issues and provided regular system maintenance.
-Installed and maintained software and hardware components.
-Configured and upgraded network and equipment as needed.
-Was the point of contact for several high level clients and maintained significant portion of customer accounts.
